In Ezekiel's temple vision, the same form takes on a fractional meaning: one-sixth of a hin of oil or one-sixth of an ephah of grain (Ezek 4:11; 46:14). Spanish sexta parte de and English 'sixth of' both signal the shift from ordinal position to measured proportion.
